issues.description: The template Lecture class declares addGuestStudents with signature addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, boolean validateInput) while the problem statement and UML specify addGuestStudents(int) and the solution implements addGuestStudents(int). This parameter mismatch will prevent students from implementing the expected method signature required by the exercise and tests, causing compilation failures or test mismatches.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the method signature in the template Lecture.java to public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents) (remove the boolean parameter) so it matches the UML, problem description, and the solution. If input validation is desired, either perform it internally or provide an overloaded helper method without changing the required public signature.
